vectors.note: artifact ref order preserved, not sorted
quote and backslash use two-char escapes
BS HT LF FF CR use short escapes
other C0 controls use lowercase 6-char escapes
DEL and C1 controls are raw UTF-8
decomposed e+U+0301 raw UTF-8, not normalized
U+FEFF U+FFFF U+FFFD inside a string are raw
identifiers may contain interior space and non-ASCII
from == to is accepted by V0
mixed escapes and raw UTF-8 in one string
LF spelled as 6-char escape instead of short
id with trailing U+2028 (White_Space, not Cc)
